strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
...? Where are we, Show?
Th-This is... the surface world.
The surface!?
And it's Tokyo... though it's been torn up like this...
Was there a war on the surface too?
Maybe so...
That's...!? Garalia's Bastole!
Hm...? Where is this?
What do we do, Shooow?
That's...!? The Dunbine! Show Zama!
Garalia, can you hear me!? This is the surface! Where people live!
If we fight here, we'll hurt the people of the surface!
Hmph! If Show the surfacer is my foe, this is enemy land! I'll destroy it!
No! First we need to find out why we came out on the surface!
It's no use, Show, she won't listen at all!
Drumlos...!? What's going on!? It's not just Garalia and me!
Heheheh... perfect. Show Zama! You've nowhere to run...!
I'm the only one left... But Show Zama, you at least...!
Garalia, stop resisting! You'll only make things worse for yourself.
Resisting!? Don't make me laugh! That's you surfacers!
This is the surface! There are forces here without end!
Yeah, yeah!
...Ngh.
Let's go back, Garalia. To Byston Well!
...Fine. Dying on the surface would be... a dog's death.
Yeah, I hate the surface... Let's fight in Byston Well, Garalia.
It seems... they've settled things.
Acquired "Skill Lv+1".
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
What are those small... insect-shaped robots?
Show! Something big is coming!?
A battleship... from this world!?
Can you hear me? State your affiliation!
This is the Federation Far East Gandor Team. I'm Commander Hazuki.
The Federation...!? I'm Show Zama. I'm Japanese!
Sorry, but at this rate the surface will be torn apart.
Lend me a hand!
Japanese? Who are you?
I'll explain everything later, I promise! Right now...!
Commander, what should we do?
We can't abandon someone in trouble, can we? I'm going!
With this many different things showing up,
it makes you want to take them all down one after another.
All right, Jun, we're heading out too...!
OK, Tetsuya!
I'm going too! These guys feel different from the ones before,
but nothing surprises me anymore!
Ah, wait for me, Koji!
The mobile suit team will launch as soon as it's ready.
They look fast. Not that it matters once we catch them...
Mia, your home... Earth... is it always at war?
...I don't know... My memory's still not complete.
What a scary place...
As long as I get to cut loose, I don't care.
Hey now, don't get the wrong idea. It's not normally this bad.
No choice, then... All units, launch! Repel the unknown enemy!
Another new model!?
Give us a break already!
...ONE... FORM...
But... what is that? It looks like a skeleton...
...Hm, did it just... speak?
Zama! Are those enemies too!?
...I don't know. I've never seen them before.
Cham?
...Show... that's... wrong... Show, I can't explain it, but that...
is something that must never come out. Show...!
Cham? Cham! Pull yourself together, what's wrong!?
Ugh... what...? Raideen?
Akira!? What's wrong? Aren't you feeling well?
Ever since that thing appeared... Raideen's been acting strange...
Raideen, are you trying to tell me something...?
Akira, when the Demon Empire showed up,
you said Raideen reacted then too, right? Think it's connected?
I don't know, Mister...
What? Just snap that bony bastard in half!
Joe, brute force isn't always the answer.
That's just like Big Bro, though.
Hmph, I don't feel a thing.
All I feel is that these guys are enemies too!
Right now, keeping it simple might work best. Let's go!
That's right, this is no time to flinch! Move forward!
Please respond, Dr. Hazuki!
Huh? There's someone over there!
Civilians!? This is a combat zone! What are you doing!?
This is Gandor. I'm Hazuki. And you are?
We're from Neo Japan. We came to Earth on Major Ulube's orders!
Neo Japan? Then you're the ones who appeared near the Barrier Satellite...
Commander, sorry, but let's talk later!
The enemy won't wait for us.
Right. I'd like you to join the battle as well. All right?
Yes, that's fine.
But I don't see any mobile suits of theirs...
No need to worry! Let's go, Domon! Master Asia!
Come forth!! Gundaaam!!
Three Gundams!?
I've never seen Gundams like those, but...
After all, they were built for the Gundam Fight!
G-Gundam Fight?
We'll talk about them later! For now, wipe out the enemy!
Well then, shall we see what they can do?
Fighting robots, huh. Hmph, show me what those Gundams can do.
Foes like these are no match for us... Come, Domon!
Yes! Master!
Gundam Fiiight! Readyyy!
Gooo!
Watch the power of my Nobel Gundam!
(Domon...? And Gundam Fighters... Could it be?)
More of them!?
They ran!?
What!? A retreat? What's going on?
Nngh, I won't let you!!
Master!?
Domon! You will act together with the Gandor Team!
Why, Master!? I'll come too! It's better if we chase them together...
Don't flatter yourself, Domon!
Even if you came, you'd only slow me down. Nothing would change!!
M-Master...
I can move more freely chasing them alone.
Work with the Gandor Team and pursue the Devil Gundam!
But...!
They are not the only enemies on the surface!
Fight alongside the Gandor Team and hone yourself!!
Master...
Do not worry, Domon.
The School of the Undefeated East won't fall so easily.
True, chasing the Devil Gundam on our own might be hard, but...
Master... Understood... Please, take care...
Good. Farewell, Domon!
And all of you in the Gandor Team, I leave Domon in your care!
That man plans to chase that enemy on his own!?
But why do you need to chase them?
They're offshoots of the Devil Gundam. If we follow them,
we'll eventually reach the Devil Gundam itself.
The Devil Gundam?
Ask Ulube to explain later.
What on earth is going on, Show?
I don't know... While I was in Byston Well,
it seems a lot has been happening on the surface.
We let a few get away. Huh, Domon?
Yeah... If Master's chasing them, there's no need to worry...
He'll contact us soon enough.
Dr. Hazuki, I'm Rain Mikamura, mechanic and doctor.
I've heard about you from my father.
I see, so you're the mysterious Gundams Captain Bright mentioned...
Hey Domon, like your master said, let's ask to join the Gandor Team.
Domon, it's fine, right? There's only so much we can find alone...
Dr. Hazuki... would you let us join the Gandor Team?
Well... I can't decide that alone, but I'll contact Major Ulube.
Thank you very much.
...Master said so. I don't mind. ...Never mind us, what about them?
Ah, Zama, are you two all right?
Yes. Thank you for your help. You saved us.
...Let me ask again... who are you? All we know is you're Japanese and
that, for now, you're on our side...?
Hey, what do we do now? Show...
Cham, keep quiet. ...It's a long story.
Don't tell me you flew in from another world,
or something like that.
Huh? Yes, from a world called Byston Well... How did you know?
Hey, Joe... looks like you hit the nail on the head.
I'm starting to get used to this.
It seems... this is no joke.
My head's getting all mixed up.
...It seems we can't just ignore this.
Zama, we won't treat you badly. Will you come with us?
Even if I said no... it seems that's my only option.
